name: T75
imageNote: Vehicle illustration from the original product page; not a fitment or endorsement claim.
description: T75 is an automotive paint protection film in the T Series, with a clear gloss finish and a brochure-listed thickness of 7.5 mil.
features: TPU film construction
Heat-assisted scratch recovery described in the brochure
Impact and abrasion resistance described in the brochure
care: Avoid touching the film, especially its edges, for the first 3 days after installation.
The brochure recommends washing approximately one week after installation, once the film has fully dried.
Avoid brushes, abrasive compounds, abrasive sponges and adhesive items on the surface.
Have removal performed by a professional installer.
storage: Store flat in the original packaging, away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures. The brochure recommends 20 ± 2 °C and 40–60% relative humidity.
warrantyNote: This is the period printed in the supplied brochure, not confirmation of regional coverage. Confirm the applicable terms and installation requirements before purchase.
